verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a tax API platform, but the evidence documents no bulk or batch endpoint. Products, calculations, transactions and refunds are all created one at a time. Pricing a 'set of products' within a single calculation, or a platform transaction spawning an order and fee pair, is single-request line-item handling, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
